name: OpenVibe.Quest
description: OpenVibe.Quest will be the network's shared quest and rewards system: quests that span every OpenVibe site, from a streamer's getting-started steps on OpenVibe.Live to community challenges, cosmetics and OpenCoins, moddable and open to anyone through the API.

pillars.title: Quests everywhere
pillars.text: One quest log across every OpenVibe site.

pillars.title: Make your own
pillars.text: Streamers, modders and developers create quests for their communities.

pillars.title: Built for games
pillars.text: The quest layer for OpenVibe.Games and its creators.

keywords: openvibe quest, quests, achievements, rewards, gamification, streamer quests
